scores.tell: Whole DJ deck is uniform glossy molded plastic with soft rounded buttons and headphones; no matte/shiny contrast, no fine detail.
Fabric seat has fine stitching and a soft matte weave. Metal tubes are a bit too uniformly chrome-gray, and the base is smooth.
Cat fur is a matte, soft-velvet blur with little texture. Eyes and bell are glossy. The surface is a bit airbrushed and clay-like.
Gold star has clean, simple faceted metal with a gem and a few highlights. It is slightly plasticky, but the smooth stylization fits.
Truss and lamp body are smooth CG metal with clean highlights. The light beam is a smeared, ghosted gradient, an AI-looking blur.
Wood on the saloon doors is smooth, with only faint broad grain streaks. The hinges are fine. The glossy lacquer is even across the whole object.
Snorkel mask is a milky blue plastic with soft smeared translucency. The wood deck has painterly smudges. The glass reads vague.
Telescope has a good matte/gloss mix: white enamel tube, brass bands, glass lens, and wood grain with fine streaks. Only a slight over-lacquer.
Palm leaves and trunk are smooth, glossy and clay-like with no fine detail. The sand has soft grain, and the style fits the real cards.
Stone table and stools have a painterly marble smudge and a soft, blurry checker top. The grass is brushy. It looks more like a painted illustration than a smooth 3D render.
